title: I JUST CAN'T TAKE THIS ANYMORE!!! I never voted for BBM and Duterte. But i can't stand anymore sa mga fake news and manipulation sa mga tao. This alleged photo submitted by the AI Zaldy Co says there is a family picture of M Rumualdez and his family.... BUT IT IS FAKE. You can see from the original photo and compare it to the family photo with the suitcases. IT WAS STRETCHED IN JUST TO FIT THE FRAME. at sino namang loko family picture sa garahe ilalagay at tabe pa ng mga garbage bag???? The faces become thinner, the shadows of the edge of the photo are sure to be edited, and if you zoom further, you will see they poorly erased the garbage bag, which shows how poorly it was edited..... STOP THE MANIPULATION!!!! Maawa naman kayo sa kapwa natin Pilipino pinagloloko ninyo just to have your agenda, gusto ninyo pagaway awayin ang mga tao.... Forgive me God, if i burst out like this. May you forgive also the people, for they are just being manipulated by the devil..... at sa mga taong gustong si Sarah maging presidente, maghintay kayo malapit na ang 2028 at sabihin nyo she should face the allegation if she really is INNOCENT para matigil na, im sure if proven NOT guilty by the court, she will win landslide in 2028. The more she keeps running away, the more she looks guilty.... kaya nakakapagod na.
